name: eevee-bowl-v2
description: eevee-bowl-v2 — written by the Forge Assistant. Replace this line with what the part is for, what it fits, and anything it has to clear.

part.description: Which piece to build: 0 the base, 1 an ear, 2 the tail, 3 the fur collar

bowl_diameter.description: Rim diameter of the stainless bowl insert that drops in

bowl_height.description: Height of the bowl insert from its base to its rim

fit_clearance.description: Insert seat clearance -- radial gap between the bowl rim and the seat bore, all the way round

wall.description: Thickness of the ring wall (five 0.4 mm perimeters plus margin)

bowl_lift.description: Air under the bowl's base once it is seated

rim_capture.description: Plain wall standing above the seat, around the bowl rim

lip_width.description: How far the seat ledge reaches in under the bowl rim

foot_height.description: Height of the arcaded base zone

feet_count.description: Number of piers around the arcaded base -- flat-bottomed, so the optional stick-on rubber feet (bought separately) have somewhere flat to land

collar_leaves.description: How many leaves in the fur collar

collar_length.description: Root-to-tip length of one collar leaf -- clamped so the collar's band fits the base's neck

collar_overlap.description: How much each leaf overlaps its neighbour, as a fraction of the pitch

collar_droop.description: How far the leaves lean out from vertical. 42-48 deg is the window where the leaf tips are support-free as well as their undersides

collar_jitter.description: Per-leaf variation, so the collar reads as fur and not as a machined ring

collar_seed.description: Change it for a different collar; the same number always builds the same one

collar_cup.description: How far each leaf's front arches above its own edges. 0 is a flat cut-out; 0.3 and up reads as fur

collar_clearance_mm.description: Slide-fit gap between the collar's bore and the base's neck, all the way round -- the collar is its own printed piece, never fused to the base

body_swell.description: How far the shoulder (above the neck) swells past the neck radius, as a fraction of it. 0 is a straight cylinder

ear_length.description: Root to tip of an ear, not counting its peg

ear_width.description: Width of an ear at its widest

tail_length.description: Root to tip of the tail

tail_width.description: Width of the tail at its widest

appendage_thickness.description: Blade thickness of the ears and the tail; must bury the ear peg / tail dovetail

appendage_rounding.description: Fillet on the top edge of an ear or tail; stepped down if the kernel refuses it

peg_diameter.description: Ear peg diameter, and the matching socket in the base rim

peg_length.description: How far an ear's peg goes into its socket

ear_clearance_mm.description: Ear slot clearance, per side -- slide fit between the peg and its socket

dovetail_width_mm.description: Width of the tail's dovetail boss at its widest (the flared head). Mounts on the back; the flare resists it pulling straight off once slid on

dovetail_length_mm.description: How far the tail's dovetail socket slides onto the base's boss

dovetail_clearance_mm.description: Slide-fit gap on the tail's dovetail flanks
